narr: A continued monsoonal weather pattern resulted in scattered, slow-moving thunderstorms across the region. Localized flash flooding was reported in low-lying areas of I-10 and within normally dry draws.
ev: Flash flooding of the normally dry Fourmile Draw with 4 to 5 feet of water over North Lake Road. Duration is an estimation.
lsr: Flash flooding 4-5 feet deep of (normally dry) Fourmile Draw over North Lake Road.
